assets.discovery_evidence: Homepage AND /entreprise-ahma/ both render a 'Mot du Président' (Word from the President) widget whose source is https://ahmabtp.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/president.jpg (350x233 JPEG, Canon EOS-1D X EXIF preserved). The widget's points at /team/ait-haj-my-abdelghni/. The /team/ait-haj-my-abdelghni/ page identifies that link target as 'AIT HAJ MY ABDELGHNI — Président Directeur Général'. Therefore the portrait is the President with high confidence. Note: the team-page itself points at Untitled-1yyyy.png which is the company logo (site bug — that URL serves the AHMA logo, not a portrait). The president.jpg URL is the only canonical owner-face asset on the site.
assets.composition: chest-up, seated at desk, dark suit, Moroccan flag visible behind right shoulder, office bookshelves
